# CardPop

> Australia's trading card marketplace for Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh and sports cards. Buy, sell, and trade authenticated cards with live AUD pricing and buyer protection.

## Marketplace & Shop
- [Marketplace](https://cardpop.com.au/marketplace): Browse and buy trading cards listed by Australian sellers, with buyer protection.
- [CardPop Shop](https://cardpop.com.au/shop): The official CardPop shop — sealed product and singles sold directly.
- [Shop — Singles](https://cardpop.com.au/shop/singles): Individual single cards available to buy now.
- [Shop — Sealed Boxes](https://cardpop.com.au/shop/sealed-boxes): Sealed booster boxes and cases.
- [Collections](https://cardpop.com.au/collections): Curated collections grouping cards by set, franchise and theme.

## Prices & Market Data
- [Card Prices](https://cardpop.com.au/prices): Live AUD market pricing for trading cards, sourced from recent sales.
- [Markets](https://cardpop.com.au/markets): Market trends and movements across trading card categories.
- [Australian Markets](https://cardpop.com.au/australian-markets): Pricing and demand data specific to the Australian market.
- [Analytics](https://cardpop.com.au/analytics): Aggregate analytics and reporting across the marketplace.

## Grading
- [Grading](https://cardpop.com.au/grading): Everything about card grading — how it works and who does it.
- [What Is Grading?](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/what-is-grading): An introduction to trading card grading.
- [Grading Scales](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/scales): How the major grading scales (PSA, Beckett and others) compare.
- [Grading Companies](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/companies): Directory of grading companies and their services.
- [Local Graders](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/local-graders): Grading services available within Australia.
- [Submission Partners](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/submission-partners): Partners that handle grading submissions on your behalf.
- [Grade Estimator](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/estimator): Estimate the likely grade of a card before submitting it.
- [Grading ROI Calculator](https://cardpop.com.au/grading/roi-calculator): Estimate the return on investment of grading a card.

## Community & Events
- [Community](https://cardpop.com.au/community): The CardPop community hub — forums, traders and local groups.
- [Community Forum](https://cardpop.com.au/community/forum): Discussion forum for collectors and traders.
- [Local Traders](https://cardpop.com.au/community/local-traders): Find traders near you across Australia.
- [Retailers](https://cardpop.com.au/community/retailers): Directory of trading card retailers.
- [Whatnot Sellers](https://cardpop.com.au/community/whatnot): Australian card sellers streaming on Whatnot.
- [Events](https://cardpop.com.au/events): Card shows, community events, store events and trade events.
- [Card Shops Directory](https://cardpop.com.au/card-shops): Directory of trading card shops across Australia.

## Guides & Blog
- [Blog](https://cardpop.com.au/blog): Articles, guides and news about trading cards and collecting.
- [Photography Guide](https://cardpop.com.au/photography-guide): How to photograph cards well for listings.

- [Contact](https://cardpop.com.au/contact): How to get in touch with CardPop.
- [FAQ](https://cardpop.com.au/faq): Answers to common questions about buying, selling and grading.
- [Trust & Safety](https://cardpop.com.au/trust-safety): How CardPop protects buyers and sellers.
- [Returns](https://cardpop.com.au/returns): The returns policy for purchases.
- [Shipping](https://cardpop.com.au/shipping): Shipping options, timings and costs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cardpop.com.au/privacy-policy): How CardPop handles personal data.

- [Accessibility](https://cardpop.com.au/accessibility): CardPop's accessibility commitments.
